_comment: Global NPC identity table. Keyed by the only authorable IsaacPeople asset directories (episode humans[].asset). Asset-fixed only: name, caption, job, usd_file, appearance_attributes_gt, and required official reference_images. Preferences / need / intent / persona / goals belong in episode YAML. Appearance goldens are authored from 1024px four-view Omniverse renders of each local main USD (not inferred from the folder label). Isaac folder labels (Medical/Police/…) often do NOT match the visible costume.

_schema.name: unique human-readable display name (assigned; not present in the USD)
_schema.usd_file: required main USD filename relative to the asset directory
_schema.caption: one-line natural-language description for prompts
_schema.job: role inferred from visible costume (not blindly from the Isaac folder label)
_schema.appearance_attributes_gt: canonical atomic golden list for human_appearance
_schema.reference_images: required repo-relative paths to official NVIDIA Isaac People thumbnails; exposed only through the episode-scoped profile tool and labelled with name + job

excluded.biped_demo: runtime rig payload required by Biped_Setup.usd, not an episode NPC
excluded.female_child_casual_01: thumbnail only — USD not present locally
excluded.male_child_casual_01: thumbnail only — USD not present locally
excluded.People/DH_Characters: Digital Human characters are outside the supported episode catalog.
